debts.title: Source and execution-subject admission
debts.activation: Any assertion about current source authority or native Tranche-7/ATC execution.
debts.closure_requirement: Pin repository commits, source bytes, release, dependencies and exact results. Retrieved main pages and older local attachments cannot stand in for the final execution subject.
debts.earned_scope: Bounded execution subjects and reviews are identity-bound; production release/dependency execution remains downstream.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: The later native release must bind its own exact execution subject.

debts.title: Endogenous constitutive closure
debts.activation: A proposal claims that the event is generated by the permitted scientific state.
debts.closure_requirement: Name every causal input and choice; close guard, resolution, construction, identity and outcome rules; challenge administrative and hidden-state dependence.
debts.earned_scope: The supported one-locus two-sector law consumes present reference-stage state, resolves or fails closed, and constructs the declared target.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No arbitrary-locus, arbitrary-graph or production scheduler authority.

debts.title: Temporal stage and historical operand
debts.activation: A witness uses consumed current, threshold crossing, or a previous state rather than the declared present reconstruction.
debts.closure_requirement: Bind the exact stage and all required past preimages; show replay and reset semantics.
debts.earned_scope: Reference-stage consumption, independent roles, lineage, reset and replay are explicit; no hidden historical trigger operand is introduced.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Historical predicates outside the present-state law need a separate contract.

debts.title: Analysis-to-constitutive consumption
debts.activation: A source analysis object becomes a physical event guard.
debts.closure_requirement: Admit the successor consumer, stage and complete-profile identity without relabeling a diagnostic as an existing actuator.
debts.earned_scope: The research consumer executes the reviewed source prescription with profile operands plus source/outer-record event identity; it is not merely a diagnostic.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Production consumer/profile admission is later Phase 9 work.

debts.title: Branch and regularity applicability
debts.activation: A claim uses a structural chart, current slaving derivative, or classical section derivative.
debts.closure_requirement: Supply the exact branch, association, domain and derivatives; retain RG2b Lipschitz alternatives and kink/rank boundaries.
debts.earned_scope: No structural chart, slaved-current section derivative or RG2b regularity claim is made. The actual C1 potential assumptions remain attached to G5-G6.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Activate for CI/RG2b or a classical structural/section derivative claim; do not inherit OS regularity.

debts.title: Functional, tangent, metric and normalization
debts.activation: A claim invokes structural alpha, joint-state energy or magnitude comparisons.
debts.closure_requirement: Instantiate the complete functional and constrained domain; distinguish fixed W from temporal W/Z variation; remove/classify nulls.
debts.earned_scope: The used resource norms, mean-zero tangent and spectral/return bounds are specified. The result is resource contraction, not an unspecified joint (C,W) energy contraction.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No joint-state contraction, arbitrary tangent or structural energy is supplied.

debts.title: Physical discrimination of a trigger
debts.activation: A numerical or structural witness is claimed to warrant an RC topology response.
debts.closure_requirement: Retain no-event and consumer-off controls; distinguish softening, numerical certification, history loss and actual graph-response effects.
debts.earned_scope: Unsplit and history-reset controls retain obstruction; the prescribed fission admits both roles into return domains, including the coupled environment.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No arbitrary-state trigger sufficiency or unique-physical-remedy claim.

debts.title: Mode-to-locus and half-edge lift
debts.activation: A mode or response is claimed to determine graph surgery.
debts.closure_requirement: Specify coordinate meaning, sign/degeneracy handling, loops, partition and covariance; compare competing lifts.
debts.earned_scope: Exact decorated edge sectors, the supported 2+2 surgery and its covariance/lineage are specified; the unaffected-support counterexample excludes arbitrary embeddings.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No arbitrary orbit cardinality, approximate clustering or generic mode-to-edit rule.

debts.title: Within/across-family resolution order
debts.activation: A law compares candidates or operation families.
debts.closure_requirement: State units, score/order/exclusivity, margins and unresolved outcomes; do not infer cross-family comparability.
debts.earned_scope: No multi-locus ranking or cross-family comparison is claimed; unresolved alternatives do not become an ordering.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Activate if competing loci/families are ranked or a new exclusivity rule is claimed.

debts.title: Finite-precision equivariance and threshold certainty
debts.activation: Exact covariance or stable physical decisions are claimed in a numerical implementation.
debts.closure_requirement: Use exact comparisons/enclosures or declared robust domains; challenge relabelings, orientations and threshold ties.
debts.earned_scope: Exact covariance, certified allocation and finite represented comparisons are earned.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Universal binary64 threshold/quantization covariance across the whole research domain is not proved.

debts.title: Batch and sequential critical pairs
debts.activation: Disjoint events or an atomic rewrite are claimed equivalent to sequential edits.
debts.closure_requirement: Prove combined reference/history/resource maps, intermediate admission, and required equality notions; account for global reset effects.
debts.earned_scope: One transaction and replay do not claim batch/sequential equivalence. Earlier G7 references to transfer/replay are context, not evidence discharging this debt.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Activate for disjoint/batch critical-pair equivalence; intermediate readmission and equality still require proof.

debts.title: Complete finite graph/template mechanics
debts.activation: A template is claimed graph-generic or collision-free.
debts.closure_requirement: Close endpoint roles, loops, parallel edges, fresh IDs, boundary mappings and any finite template grammar.
debts.earned_scope: The paired and bounded embedded templates have explicit incidence and lineage.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Generic finite graphs, loops, parallel-edge/template coverage and arbitrary surroundings are not established.

debts.remaining_or_reactivation: A later production rounding/conservation policy is required; no silent balancing or exact binary64 conservation claim.
